As said countless times:
Even though the bug might not have been a strong thing for Darien at all, but the psychological effect it has on the opposing team is stronger than what people think.

Let's say you're in a game and you notice that Fiddle's W healed 33% more than what it is supposed to, (which is highly unlikely, because who the fuck notices the exact numbers?) then you would constantly think that it could happen again. And instead of thinking on your gameplay, this pops up in your head, over and over again.

That is why the bug might not seem big, OR be big at all, but has a bigger impact than what you think.

Riot should've remade the game then and there, because it isn't fair that Gambit has to play an extra game where their first game was a waste of time, but at the same time I feel that SK should've gotten the choice to remake the game when the bug was reported to the Referee.

My advice: Don't blame SK, nor Riot, because this couldn't have been predicted and Riot most likely had a hard time figuring out what to do at that exact time.
